}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:46.639
    | text      = So there's a slight game being played here because the term czar is not really an official
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:50.779
    | text      = title in the government.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:52.960
    | text      = Presidents often delegate certain areas of policy to a particular official and then the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:56.960
    | text      = media will take to calling them things like the climate czar or energy czar.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:01.379
    | text      = In this case, it is true that Biden chose Harris to be the point person on migration
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:05.159
    | text      = issues back when they were first elected in twenty twenty one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:07.960
    | text      = And you could make an argument that therefore she would be the border czar or something.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:13.820
    | text      = It's not accurate to what she was responsible for, given that her role was more about the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:17.679
    | text      = larger issue than just the border.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:19.960
    | text      = But it would also be a little bit inaccurate to pretend that there's no basis for this
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:24.200
    | text      = title.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:25.200
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:26.200
    | text      = It's not an official title, and it's generally been used as a catchphrase to attack Kamala
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:29.679
    | text      = Harris since.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:31.000
    | text      = For instance, in February twenty twenty two, Texas Representative Ronnie Jackson tried
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:35.080
    | text      = to pass the Borders are Accountability Act, which would make Harris visit the border every
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:39.600
    | text      = sixty days, along with a number of other requirements that he wanted to impose.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:43.960
    | text      = Yeah, that'd be fun.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:45.159
    | text      = Anyone who watched the RNC would notice that they were largely animated by a fear and hatred
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:50.320
    | text      = of immigrants with signs and chants of send them back, making frequent appearances.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:55.299
    | text      = One of the clear elements of this messaging was that many of the speakers complained about
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:58.820
    | text      = Kamala Harris specifically calling her the, quote, Borders are.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:02.559
    | text      = This was an effort in branding, and it's pretty, pretty easy to see through.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:06.600
    | text      = And that's why it's so important to someone like Alex.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:09.980
    | text      = After the RNC, there were articles and outlets like Vox that were explaining this very clear
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:13.980
    | text      = and transparent GOP messaging campaign and how it's not really accurate.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:18.720
    | text      = The Vox sub headline for their article is, quote, No, Kamala Harris is not the Borders
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:23.759
    | text      = are, but that doesn't matter to Republicans.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:26.200
    | text      = The article was attempting to explain that the HHS and DHS have responsibility for the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:53.279

{{TranscriptBlock
